title: TRICON-FAIR: TRIPLET CONTRASTIVE LEARNING FOR MITIGATING SOCIAL BIAS IN PRE-TRAINED LANGUAGE MODELS
findings: The proposed TriCon-Fair method successfully reduced religious stereotype scores (Religion SS) across all tested models (BERT, ALBERT, GPT-2, Llama2-7B) on the StereoSet benchmark. For instance, on BERT, the Religion SS was lowered from a baseline of 59.70 to 57.13. This reduction in bias was achieved while maintaining strong performance on general language tasks.
